name: Westerns Warmup Riverside B 2026
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternsWarmupRiversideB2026#73273-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

**This is a twin competition with [Westerns Warmup Riverside A 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternsWarmupRiversideA2026). You may only sign up for ONE competition (A or B).**

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

**Food is NOT allowed in the venue. This competition is scheduled to take place after normal lunch hours.**

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
